subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: The Nobel laureate poet who founded Santiniketan (later Visva-Bharati University), advocating a naturalistic style of education conducted amid nature, emphasising joy, creativity, and freedom from rigid discipline, was:
explanation: Rabindranath Tagore founded Santiniketan (1901), which grew into Visva-Bharati University, championing an education rooted in nature, creative freedom, and joyful learning — distinct from Gandhi's Wardha Scheme (craft-centred Basic Education) or Aurobindo's integral-education philosophy.
